biotools.summary: CRISPR-GEM is a machine learning model that predicts the downstream effects of CRISPR gene editing by constructing a synthetic gene regulatory network. It identifies optimal CRISPR target genes by modulating experimental group GRNs to motivate transcriptomic shifts toward a target group phenotype.
